scope: Optional registered-tool replay; synthetic host fixtures, scripted assistant turns, no live model requests.

method.cold: one first-invocation sample per case, not process-cold
method.clock: root Pi tool_execution_start to tool_execution_end; session setup and scripted turns excluded
method.order: serial; starting engine rotates by case index, sample index and seed
method.caveat: One host and one run; no confidence interval, production weights or universal speedup. Different product limits remain visible.

provenance.policy: Benchmark HEAD may precede uncommitted implementation; source hashes, not HEAD alone, identify the measured code. Absolute paths and private config are omitted.

implementations.name: codemode
implementations.clock: Root tool_execution_start to tool_execution_end; session setup, scripted model turns and session shutdown excluded
implementations.lifecycle: Fresh isolated Pi AgentSession per invocation; actual registered tool and nested Pi pipeline; no live model

implementations.clock: Root tool_execution_start to tool_execution_end; session setup, scripted model turns and session shutdown excluded

extension.note: Entry hash is checked against the measured receipt. Dependency metadata was inspected at export; imported dependency bytes are not recursively fingerprinted.
